SELECT R. ID AS RECORDID, R.STAFF_NAME, STAFF.COMP_NAME, STAFF.DEP_NAME, STAFF.JOB_NAME, R.CAUSE, R.START_TIME AS PATCHDATE, R.CREATE_TIME AS RECORDDATE, R.PROCESS_ID, R.STAFF_BADGE, R.CREATE_TIME, R.WORK_MONTH FROM SMT_REPLACE_APPLICATION R INNER JOIN SMT_STAFF STAFF ON R.STAFF_BADGE=STAFF.BADGE
R.STAFF_BADGE LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{query.staffBadge}),'%')
AND R.STAFF_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{query.staffName}),'%')
AND R.CREATE_TIME between to_date(#{query.startTime},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') and to_date(#{query.endTime},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
AND STAFF.COMP_ID IN ( SELECT DISTINCT SPB.COMP_ID from SMT_PARK_BU SPB
SPB.PARK_ID IN
#{id}
)
ORDER BY R.CREATE_TIME DESC
